newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Algeria sign nuclear cooperation agreement.
newsitem.headline: China, Algeria sign nuclear cooperation agreement.

text.p: China and Algeria have signed an accord pledging cooperation on the peaceful use of nuclear technology, the official Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The pact was signed during a state visit by Algerian President Liamine Zeroual.
The Chinese official media have described Zeroual's visit as aimed mainly at boosting economic ties.
The nuclear technology pact pledges the two sides to cooperate in building research and production facilities for radio isotopes to be used in medicine, agriculture and industry, Xinhua said.
The pact was signed by Boubakeur Benbouzid, Algeria's minister of universities and scientific research, and Jiang Xinxiong, chairman of China's State Atomic Energy Authority, Xinhua said.
The agency gave no further details of the agreement but said officials of the two sides also held talks on medical care and public health.

Zeroual met Vice Premier Zhu Rongji, China's top economic strategist, on Friday, and the Algerian president was quoted by Xinhua as saying Algeria wanted to learn from China's experience in economic development.
Zeroual is also scheduled to make a stop in Shanghai, China's industrial centre, during his stay.
